behaviour: Every static plant fixture outside the type gate job that edits a Python file under hooks or scripts keeps that file's strict type error count within tests/TYPE_BASELINE.json, and the plant for a pull request job outside the gate makes scripts.ci_wiring report its own diagnostic and leaves the needs of the gate-required job unchanged.
seam: scripts.type_gate.measure over a copy of the tracked hooks, scripts and tests trees with a plant's edits applied; scripts.ci_wiring.check over the workflows of this checkout with the edits of lint.check-every-pull-request-job-is-a-need-of-gate-required applied; the needs of the gate-required job of .github/workflows/test.yml with and without that plant's edits
